exposure: antenatal visit started at third trimester
presence of meconium stained amniotic fluid
cohort: Mothers who delivered in Bale zone hospitals in Southeast Ethiopia, with cases being deliveries resulting in stillbirth and controls being deliveries with live births.
finding: Preceding birth interval of <24 months, starting antenatal visits in the third trimester, referral from another health facility, presence of meconium-stained amniotic fluid, labor length >=24 hours, and giving birth to a baby <2500g were determinants of stillbirth.
